author: J.F.Gmelin, 1789
summary: 겨울에 아주 드물게 찾아오는 오리로, 강원도 속초 청초호와 고성군, 제주도 성산포, 낙동강 하구 등지에서 겨울을 난다. 논, 호수, 소택지에서 지내며, 낮에는 소택지 풀숲에서 쉬다가 저녁부터 새벽까지 먹이를 찾는다. 물풀을 즐겨 먹고 물속 곤충과 조개류도 먹는다. 북아메리카 대륙 중서부에서 번식하며, 호수 가운데의 작은 섬이나 물가에서 떨어진 풀밭의 오목한 땅에 마른풀로 둥지를 짓고 크림빛 흰 알 8~13개를 24~25일 동안 품는다.

art.subject: American Wigeon (Mareca americana), adult male in winter, as seen in Korea from November to March: forehead and central crown creamy white; a broad glossy dark green band from the eye sweeping back to the nape, where the two bands meet; rest of the head and upper neck pale greyish-buff, densely speckled black; breast and flanks pinkish-brown; back and scapulars pinkish-brown, finely vermiculated, darker than in Eurasian Wigeon; a white patch at the rear of the flanks before the black undertail coverts; tertials black with white edges; bill pale blue-grey with a black tip and a thin black line at the base; dark eye; legs grey.
art.pose: swimming slowly at the edge of a marsh, side view
art.scene: Korean winter: a coastal lagoon-like lake with reedy marsh and rice paddies nearby; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view swimming: creamy-white forehead and crown stripe, broad dark green band from eye to nape, black-speckled greyish-buff face and neck, pinkish-brown breast, flanks and back, white rear-flank patch, black stern, blue-grey bill with black tip

adult male, head detail in profile: white central crown, dark green band from behind the eye meeting its pair on the nape, speckled pale face, small pale blue-grey bill with a black tip and black base line
art.build: Medium-sized dabbling duck, about 48cm, a little smaller than a Mallard, with a rounded head, steep forehead, short neck and a small, short bill much shorter than the head. Legs short, grey. At rest the wingtips reach close to the tail tip; tail pointed, often slightly raised. In flight adult males show a large white patch on the upperwing coverts, a green speculum, a white belly and white axillaries under the wing.
avoid: Do not paint a chestnut head and grey back; that is Eurasian Wigeon (Mareca penelope). This male has a speckled grey-buff head and a pinkish-brown back.
Do not paint a thin pale eye-line instead of the broad dark green band.
Do not paint a long bill or a yellow or orange bill; it is short and pale blue-grey with a black tip.
Do not add a crest or long tail plumes.
